params.prompt:
Exactly 32 complete separate full-body drawings, FOUR columns and EIGHT rows, no extra cells.
Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and rounded stocky torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.
IDENTITY: The ONE rounded stocky BLACK Sproto in reference image1. Large smooth rounded BLACK head and thick black neck with a softly rounded chin. TWO enormous circular YELLOW eye surrounds with small glossy BLACK round pupils and tiny white glints. Subtle curved black brows, short broad rounded BLACK nose. Very broad curved RED closed smiling lips with a simple curved seam, no teeth or yellow jaw. FOUR pointed RED triangular spikes along the back/left side of the head. Preserve the distinctive BLACK body and RED spikes, never recolor skin blue. A thick RED rolled collar surrounds the neck, RED tunic with broad YELLOW shoulder bands and segmented YELLOW lower trim. Small fixed WHITE circular medallion at center of collar with a tiny BLACK abstract mark, no readable lettering. Extend cropped lower body conservatively with matching RED loose trousers and BLACK simple slippers with YELLOW soles. BLACK bare arms and hands, no boxing gloves. Chunky rounded torso, low pelvis, two complete attached arms and two complete attached legs. No hair, crown, cape, staff, weapon or extra actor. Keep the black face readable through a few charcoal same-hue shading steps and subtle dark-grey edges, not blue highlights.
Row 1: relaxed combat guard; subtle exhale guard; forward guarded step with near foot leading; weight passes over near planted foot.
Row 2: forward guarded step with far foot leading; weight passes over far planted foot; forward dash with low lean and both legs anatomically connected; jump anticipation with hips lowered and knees bent.
Row 3: rising jump with both low-rooted knees gathered; falling jump with legs extending for landing; low crouched landing with both soles grounded; light punch anticipation with shoulder and elbow coiling.
Row 4: fully extended straight punch toward the right; punch retracting to guard; uppercut low-body coil; clear rising uppercut with elbow then fist high, two legs retained.
Row 5: side kick chamber, near knee lifted from LOW hip, support foot planted; half-extended kick with knee opening; fully extended waist-height side kick, low hip, ankle and toes aligned; kick knee retracts before planting.
Row 6: low sweeping kick with one grounded bent support leg; sweep recovery returning over the low pelvis; airborne kick chamber with both legs originating at lower body; airborne kick full extension with coherent second leg folded.
Row 7: recoiling from a chest hit, head and torso remain joined; solid two-arm high guard; reaching forward to catch with clearly visible open hand; close grab hold with both arms bent toward an imagined opponent but NO opponent drawn.
Row 8: planted forward throw follow-through without opponent; ranged SPIT anticipation with cheeks inflated and lips pursed, elbows tucked back; open-mouth SPIT release to RIGHT with forward head snap, arms remain at ribs; broad triumphant Team Special finishing stance, complete body. Never fire from a hand. Engine draws projectile; do not draw one. Preserve BLACK skin/head/hands, RED rear spikes and rolled collar, enormous YELLOW eyes, red smile, yellow outfit bands and fixed white medallion in every frame. NO blue skin or blue highlights. Compact flat limited palette shading, no gradients, glowing body, text, shadows, effects or projectiles. Background pure MAGENTA, not the cyan reference background.
